subject: Termination / Deprovisioning Evidence for BluePeak - request for SCIM/SAML samples
messages:
From: Marta Alvarez <marta@bluepeakmedical.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: it-security@bluepeakmedical.com
Date: Sat, 20 Sep 2025 09:12:00 -0400
Subject: Termination / Deprovisioning Evidence for BluePeak - request for SCIM/SAML samples

Karthik —

Thanks for the quick onboarding call last week. As part of our security closeout checklist ahead of contract termination for one business unit, our InfoSec team needs proof that deprovisioning flows run reliably and that contractors/service accounts are being handled separately from user accounts. Can you provide the following by end of next week?

- A sample SCIM delta that shows a complete deprovisioning event (user disabled -> removed) for a contractor account (anonymized)
- Examples of SAML assertions before and after account termination so we can validate assertion attributes are stripped (NameID, groups, entitlements)
- A short diagram or role-mapping that indicates service accounts vs human roles and least-privilege boundaries

If any of this is already in a SOC 2/SIG artifact bundle, point us to that link; otherwise attachments are fine. We'll treat samples as redacted; we only need headers and attribute values (no PII).

Appreciate it — we have an audit window starting Sept 29.

Marta Alvarez
Head of IT Security
BluePeak Medical

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Marta Alvarez <marta@bluepeakmedical.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 20 Sep 2025 13:08:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Termination / Deprovisioning Evidence for BluePeak - request for SCIM/SAML samples

Marta —

Thanks for the note. We can deliver redacted artifacts that show the exact flow you're asking for. I'll coordinate a small package: one SCIM delta CSV capturing the deprovisioning event, one SAML assertion before termination and one after, and a one-page role/service-account mapping diagram.

Quick clarifications so we provide exactly what you need:
- For SCIM delta, do you prefer a single-user timeline (disable -> delete) or a batch delta covering a 24h window with multiple events? We can do either; single-user timeline is smaller.
- For SAML assertions, we'll redact emails but preserve NameID format, groups, and the authnInstant. Is that acceptable?
- We'll include a short narrative describing the guardrails that prevent service accounts from being deprovisioned by user offboarding flows.

Neha/Vivek — can you pull a deprovisioning sample and a SAML pair from the BluePeak tenant (anonymize user ids) and drop the artifacts to the shared Drive link. ETA Tue 9/23 EOD?

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Director, Customer Security & Onboarding
Redwood Inference

From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 22 Sep 2025 07:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Termination / Deprovisioning Evidence for BluePeak - request for SCIM/SAML samples

Karthik / Vivek —

Attached: scim-delta-deprovisioning-sample.csv, saml-assertion-sample.txt, role-mapping-service-accounts.png (see Drive folder link). Notes below.

Attachment notes (redacted):
- scim-delta-deprovisioning-sample.csv -> single-user timeline for user u_contractor_43 (timestamps, event_type=delete, previous state=inactive). Fields: id, userName (redacted), active, meta.created, meta.lastModified, operations (delete).
- saml-assertion-sample.txt -> two assertions: assertion_A (pre-termination) contains NameID format=persistent, groups: [clinical-read, analytics-sandbox]; assertion_B (post-termination) is an empty assertion with authnInstant still present but no groups and NameID removed (NameID->urn:uuid:REDACTED).
- role-mapping-service-accounts.png -> diagram shows service-account namespace separated by prefix svc_ and an RBAC policy snippet: "svc_* -> service-role (no console), human_* -> user-role (console + API)."

Process guarantees to call out in your audit:
1) SCIM provisioning rule uses a deprovisioning flag: when contract_end_date <= today, we transition active=false, then queue for deletion after 14 days.
2) A background worker applies role pruning and an event is emitted to the audit log (log id: RWF-20250922-347).
3) Service accounts require a separate onboarding flow and are scoped to a different entitlement namespace to avoid accidental deletion during human offboarding.

Dropping these to the shared Drive now: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2bBluePeakEvidence

Neha Kapoor
Senior Security Engineer, Customer Trust
Redwood Inference

(Attachment stubs: scim-delta-deprovisioning-sample.csv [CSV], saml-assertion-sample.txt [text], role-mapping-service-accounts.png [image])

From: Marta Alvarez <marta@bluepeakmedical.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: it-security@bluepeakmedical.com, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 22 Sep 2025 09:05:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Termination / Deprovisioning Evidence for BluePeak - request for SCIM/SAML samples

Karthik / Neha —

Received — thank you. The SCIM delta and the SAML pair look exactly like what we need. A couple of quick follow-ups from our auditor:

- Can you also confirm the retention window for audit logs that show the deprovisioning event? We need to cite how long you retain the RWF-* audit ids.
- For the 14-day pending deletion window, is there an automated restore path if rehire occurs during that period? If so, please describe the restore step and who has permission.

If you can drop a small paragraph addressing the two bullets into the Drive folder, we can close this item on our SIG. Appreciate the fast turnaround — I'll loop this back to procurement once I have the retention wording.

Best,
Marta
Head of IT Security
BluePeak Medical
